name: GD Control
description: A Geometry Dash-styled mod menu with No-Clip and Speedhack.

noclip-enabled.name: No-Clip
noclip-enabled.description: Prevents the base game layer from processing player death.

speed-multiplier.name: Speedhack
speed-multiplier.description: Scales the Cocos scheduler update rate. This affects scheduled game and UI updates.
